digest.component_or_area: external integration test suite, CI/CD workflows
propositions: External integration suite currently exercises only one live provider (Anthropic) in CI, leaving Bedrock and OpenAI regressions undetected by automation
Provider selection must become an explicit matrix dimension in workflows, with each arm credentialed and skipping loudly when credentials are absent rather than silently passing
Each provider arm must obtain credentials through appropriate mechanisms: OIDC role assumption for Bedrock on GitHub-hosted runners, API keys for Anthropic and OpenAI
Provider selection through REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE config overlays must affect all resolution paths including cfg.model, not just the model_classes table, to prevent ambient default fallback
Region resolution for Bedrock must be explicit and fail loudly when missing, with both AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION set as job environment variables
CI dogfoods the documented developer override path (config-file pointer) across all providers, verified by live test execution counts rather than inferred from job conclusions
